lines.en: I make my way over to Tojo Ramen with a specific menu item in mind, but neglect to order it once I arrive there. But I can't tell you why until I figure out something to tell myself first.
lines.zh: 我抱着某个具体的餐点念头去了 Tojo Ramen，可到了之后却没点。但在我先想出个说法给自己之前，我没法告诉你原因。

lines.en: I've been thinking a lot about ramen lately- the kind you make in cups. Not the kind served to you in half-cracked bowls by mechanical hands.
lines.zh: 最近我总是想起拉面——那种装在杯子里泡的。不是那种用裂了口的碗、由机械的手端上来的。

lines.en: There is a leak in my water cup. Tsuneyo replaces it with a mason jar and demands that I fend for myself, but she knows nothing of the things I have gone through.
lines.zh: 我的水杯漏了。Tsuneyo 换了个梅森罐给我，还要求我自力更生，可她对我经历过的事一无所知。

lines.en: The power stays on throughout the night, which is good because I am afraid of the dark now.
lines.zh: 整晚电都没断，这很好，因为我现在怕黑了。

lines.en: I've been thinking a lot about ramen lately.
I've been thinking of what's upstairs.

lines.zh: Tsuneyo 的好感度提升到了 [tsuneyo_love]！
